prompt: A hot-reload path silently skips files with unicode filenames due to encoding normalisation in the watcher. Fix confirmed. Needs regression coverage. Compress to ops handoff.
target: Root cause: encoding normalisation in file watcher drops unicode filenames. Fix: one-line normalisation patch. Open: regression tests needed for non-ASCII paths. Next: add test fixtures before ship.

prompt: Websocket reconnect churn caused by backoff timer resetting on every auth token refresh (fires at 55s, inside backoff window). Heartbeat masks the symptom. Fix requires coordinating backoff with token TTL. Compress to incident summary.
target: Root cause: backoff timer resets on auth token refresh, which fires inside the backoff window. Heartbeat conceals the churn. Fix: decouple backoff start timestamp from auth events. Next: coordinate backoff ceiling with token TTL.

prompt: Duplicate job scheduling caused by race between scheduler acquiring distributed lock and lock-TTL expiring during high-latency DB reads. Idempotency key layer prevents duplicate side-effects but not duplicate executions. Fix: lock-renewal heartbeat. Compress to three bullets.
target:
• Root cause: lock-TTL expires during slow DB reads, allowing duplicate schedulers.
• Fix: add lock-renewal heartbeat on jobs exceeding lock TTL.
• Note: idempotency keys prevent side-effect duplication but not duplicate execution — both fixes needed.

prompt: Token refresh race: concurrent requests within same validity window both receive valid tokens, one silently dropped. Auth surface must not widen. Preferred fix: per-user mutex (requires Redis). Fallback: idempotent refresh with dedup window. Compress to decision brief.
target: Issue: concurrent refresh requests produce duplicate valid tokens. Constraint: no auth surface expansion. Option A: per-user mutex via Redis — safe, needs new dep. Option B: idempotent refresh with dedup window — no new dep, slightly weaker guarantee. Next: choose based on Redis availability.

prompt: Cache invalidation bug: mutation writes update primary store but read cache checks stale version key. Hot-path read latency must stay under 20ms so full-scan invalidation ruled out. Fix: update version key on every write. Two edge cases open: bulk mutations and TTL-expired reads. Compress to patch brief.
target: Issue: read cache uses stale version key — misses mutation updates. Constraint: read latency ≤ 20ms, no full-scan flush. Fix: update version key atomically on every write. Open: bulk mutations need batch key update; TTL-expired reads need grace period. Ship primary fix first.

prompt: Plugin load order is nondeterministic due to import side-effects and PYTHONPATH variance. Fix: explicit manifest file. Migration: existing implicit registrations must move to manifest — breaking change for plugins depending on ordering accidents. Compress to migration notice.
target: Breaking change notice: plugin load order is moving from implicit (import side-effect) to explicit (manifest file). Migration required: add your plugin to the manifest in your declared load position. Plugins relying on implicit ordering accidents must declare explicit order. Timeline: manifest optional in v2, mandatory in v3.

prompt: CLI override precedence is broken: command-line flags are overridden by config file values because config is loaded last. Default fallback must still work. Fix: invert merge order. Compress to release note entry.
target: Fix: CLI flags now correctly override config file values. Previously the merge order caused config to win over explicit flags. Default fallback values are unchanged. Action required if you relied on config overriding CLI — review your flag and config combinations.

prompt: Partial sync corruption: interrupted upload records partial-file checksum in manifest, resume considers upload complete. Checksum verification must be preserved. Fix: pending-checksum field promoted to final only on successful close. Schema migration required. Compress to data-integrity brief.
target: Issue: interrupted uploads store partial checksum as final — resume incorrectly marks upload complete. Fix: add pending_checksum field; promote to checksum only on successful stream close. Schema migration required. Constraint: checksum verification preserved throughout. Next: migrate, test resume scenarios.

prompt: Session reuse bug: sessions marked reusable before teardown complete. New request acquires mid-close session. Fix: add CLOSING state between ACTIVE and REUSABLE. Transition guarded by completion callback. Compress to state-machine change note.
target: Fix: added CLOSING state to session lifecycle. Constraint: no session reuse until teardown completion callback fires. State path: ACTIVE → CLOSING → REUSABLE. Next: validate under concurrent load — connection count must not increase when sessions are in CLOSING state.

prompt: Settings mismatch: UI applies changes optimistically, persistence writes async. On slow connections second write arrives before first — persistent state doesn't match last user intent. Fix: write queue with per-setting serialisation. Compress to product bug summary.
target: Bug: settings changes on slow connections may not persist correctly — a rapid second change can overwrite the first before it saves. Fix in progress: per-setting write queue ensures changes apply in order. Workaround: wait for save confirmation before making a second change to the same setting.
